subject: SET statement
notes: kb/Work PB453 - RE-VERDICTED, NOT RE-FIXED, for the reason SR-14.9.39.3-31 records. SR32 - "If FLOAT-INFINITY, FLOAT-NOT-A-NUMBER, or FLOAT-NOT-A-NUMBER-SIGNALING is specified, identifier-14 shall reference a data item described with a standard floating-point usage" (cite.py --check 14.9.39.3 OK). RE-PROBED on this build: `SET CONTENT OF F TO FLOAT-INFINITY SIGN NEGATIVE` over `01 F USAGE FLOAT-LONG` draws COBOL1940 naming the admissible usages (FLOAT-BINARY-32/-64/-128, FLOAT-DECIMAL-16/-34), and so does the same statement over `01 N PIC S9(4)`; FLOAT-LONG is one of the implementor-defined trio of 13.18.60.4 GR13 and is NOT a standard floating-point usage, so refusing it is the rule, not a gap.
